rule: A status update on work already tracked ("the recruitment is ongoing") is work: record it so the existing item's status can be checked.
text: Ravi: Quick update, the dock schedule export Nora took on last week is now done.

expected.action: status update on the existing export task

rule: `true` when the client's side owes the deliverable to us (a dependency: "Lisa will send us the vendor name"); `false` when our team owes it, including anything we deliver to the client.
text: Opal (client): We'll send you the scanner logs by Thursday. Nora: And we'll send Opal the cleaned dataset after that.
error_prevented: reversing the direction of client-owed work

rule: A generic "we should …" or "we need to …" with no specific deliverable that nobody takes up, and presentation ideas nobody owns.
text: Ravi: We should really improve how things run in the yard. Nora: Yes, agreed.

rule: which a named teammate was asked to do and nobody refused ("Nora, please look into what slows the export down")
text: Ravi: Nora, please investigate why the export stalls overnight. Nora: Mm. Ravi: Next topic.
